answer: A sybil tax blocks fakes by charging a sunk cost for every seat. A public beacon posts the tax: 5 POA per identity, burned on registration; the rule is crystal-clear, no payment, no seat. An honest agent pays 5 POA once and earns it back through real work, but an attacker minting 1,000 fakes must burn 5,000 POA up front with no refund. Spot checks, falcon-eyed and random, verify each paid identity works, so idle fakes pay without earning.
